stable.label: matter-lab-0.1-integrated
stable.note: Matter Lab 0.1 is integrated into main after a fully green pull-request CI run. The product is NOT globally verified because the live GitHub.io deployment and real iPhone Safari have not been independently exercised from this environment.

live_pages.note: Public-site fetch could not be performed from the current execution environment because DNS/web-safe-open access was unavailable. This is not a PASS or a FAIL for the deployed page.

iphone_safari.note: No real iPhone/Safari device run has been performed.

claims: deterministic seeded initialization on the same JavaScript numerical path

active_objective: Exercise Matter Lab 0.1 from the live GitHub.io deployment, then test it on a real iPhone/Safari. After those gates, deepen the simulation instead of renaming this slice.
next_gate: Verify the public /sim/ deployment and real iPhone Safari separately. Do not set stable.verified true until the required product gates actually pass.
invariants: ChatGPT cannot self-certify its own changes
No critical project fact may live only in chat memory
Prototype experiments do not become product without a productionization gate
Tyler is not the build system or log courier
No required paid tool or runtime AI dependency
A PASS status requires evidence produced outside the code-under-test when practical
UNKNOWN must never silently become PASS
